label: Смысл
description: The masculine noun смысл (meaning, sense, point) across its full case ladder, with key collocations: смысл жизни, нет смысла, в смысле, прямой and глубокий смысл.

missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Nominative subject of existence. 1. 'Смысл' stands in the nominative as the thing that exists. 2. 'Есть' marks presence or validity. 3. The sentence says the plan 'makes sense'.

Strategic focus: Accusative direct object. 1. 'Смысл' is the accusative object of 'понял'; for this inanimate noun it matches the nominative form. 2. 'Понял' is past-tense, masculine. 3. A natural way to say 'I finally got the point'.

missions.phrase: Больше нет смысла спорить с ним.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Genitive of absence. 1. After 'нет' the noun takes the genitive: 'смысла'. 2. The infinitive 'спорить' names the pointless action. 3. Idiomatic for 'there's no point in arguing'.

missions.phrase: Он всю жизнь ищет смысл жизни.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Genitive of relation. 1. 'Смысл' is the accusative object of 'ищет', matching nominative; 'жизни' is genitive, marking the meaning belonging to life. 2. The genitive links the two nouns. 3. A famous phrase: 'the meaning of life'.

Strategic focus: Dative as indirect object. 1. 'Верю' governs the dative, so 'смыслу' takes the dative ending. 2. 'Слов' is genitive plural after the noun. 3. Shows the dative role with a verb of trust.
Strategic focus: Dative recipient. 1. 'Смыслу' is the dative recipient of the giving. 2. 'Форму' is the accusative object given. 3. Demonstrates the give-to-X pattern with an abstract noun.

Strategic focus: Instrumental of content. 1. 'Смыслом' is instrumental, naming what fills. 2. 'Глубоким' is the agreeing instrumental adjective. 3. Adjective-noun agreement: 'filled with deep meaning'.

missions.phrase: Она поёт со смыслом и душой.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Instrumental after preposition. 1. 'Со' takes the instrumental, giving 'смыслом'. 2. 'И душой' adds another instrumental noun. 3. Means doing something 'with meaning and soul'.

missions.phrase: Мы спорим о смысле этих слов.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Prepositional of topic. 1. After 'о' the noun takes the prepositional: 'смысле'. 2. 'Этих слов' is genitive plural specifying which words. 3. Marks the topic 'about the meaning of these words'.

Strategic focus: Idiomatic 'в смысле'. 1. 'В смысле' uses the prepositional and means 'in terms of' or 'in the sense of'. 2. 'Работы' is genitive, naming the respect intended. 3. A frequent clarifying connector.
Strategic focus: Adjective agreement, nominative. 1. 'Прямой' agrees with masculine 'смысл' in the nominative. 2. 'Слова' is genitive, marking possession. 3. Means the 'literal sense of the word'.

missions.phrase: Какой смысл ждать его так долго?
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Rhetorical question with nominative. 1. 'Какой' agrees with masculine 'смысл' in the nominative. 2. The infinitive 'ждать' names the questioned action. 3. Idiom for 'what's the point of waiting'.
Strategic focus: Accusative after a verb of losing. 1. 'Смысл' is the accusative object of 'потерял'. 2. 'Текст' is the nominative subject. 3. Collocation meaning 'the text lost its meaning'.

Strategic focus: Nominative plural. 1. 'Смыслы' is the accusative plural object of 'обрели'; for this inanimate noun it matches the nominative. 2. 'Слова' is the subject. 3. Shows multiple 'meanings' acquired.
Strategic focus: Genitive plural after quantity. 1. 'Много' governs the genitive plural: 'смыслов'. 2. 'Скрытых' is the agreeing genitive plural adjective. 3. Means 'many hidden meanings'.

Strategic focus: Adjective agreement with genitive complement. 1. 'Глубокий' agrees with masculine 'смысл' in the nominative. 2. 'Фразы' is genitive, marking whose meaning. 3. A vivid phrase: 'the deep meaning of the saying'.

missions.phrase: Думаю, есть смысл попробовать ещё раз.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Existential 'есть' with nominative. 1. 'Смысл' is nominative as the thing that exists. 2. 'Попробовать' is the infinitive naming the worthwhile action. 3. Idiom for 'it's worth a try'.
